name: agentic-gamedev-pipeline
description: An explicitly invoked, bounded game-feature pipeline with PRD-to-spec convergence, approval-gated development planning, director preflight, persistent writing owners, review closure, and in-game QA.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit-only preflight, engineering, review, and QA.
interface.longDescription: Runs only when the user explicitly requests the Agentic GameDev Pipeline or one named GameDev mode. It converges an approved PRD into an implementation-ready technical specification, creates a hash-traced user-approved ownership plan, then turns approved feature documents into a production-ready candidate through bounded engineering, deterministic revisions, independent review, and feature-focused runtime QA.
defaultPrompt: Use $gamedev-pipeline to run the bounded development pipeline from approved feature documents.
Use $gamedev-requirements to stabilize the product requirements for this game.
Use $gamedev-specification to converge an approved PRD into an implementation-ready technical specification.
